title: AxolotlClientConfig Violet Theme
body:
# AxolotlClientConfig Violet Theme

A colored theme for [AxolotlClientConfig](<https://codeberg.org/AxolotlClient/AxolotlClient-config>). Recommended to be used with [AxolotlClient](https://modrinth.com/mod/axolotlclient), but will work with other mods making use of the config library as well. This pack provides a **violet** color, a preview is available in the project's gallery.


**Other colors:**

- [Red](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/axolotlclientconfig-red)
- [Orange](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/axolotlclientconfig-orange)
- [Yellow](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/axolotlclientconfig-yellow)
- [Green](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/axolotlclientconfig-green)
- [Blue](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/axolotlclientconfig-blue)
